reading.text:
Reading: P2WH.instMeasurableSpace = the measurable structure on P_2(H) used for the joint Borel
measurability of the coefficients (2.3) on [0,T] x H x P_2(H) and the Borel law flows
mu, mu^- : [0,T] -> (P_2(H), W_2) of Lemma A.1. In the paper it is the Borel sigma-algebra of the
metric space (P_2(H), W_2), W_2 w.r.t. the Hilbert norm |theta|_H^2 = |x|^2+|y|^2+|z|_F^2+||u||^2
(H separable, so (P_2(H), W_2) is Polish). Equivalent descriptions: the Borel sigma-algebra of
any metric bi-Lipschitz equivalent to W_2 (same topology), or, for separable H, the sigma-algebra
generated by the evaluation maps mu |-> mu(A) (A Borel) / mu |-> int phi dmu restricted to P_2 —
these coincide with the W_2-Borel sigma-algebra. A strictly coarser or finer sigma-algebra would
change what "jointly Borel" means and would be a mismatch.

comparison.text:
P2WH.instMeasurableSpace := borel (P2WH HX HY HZY HUY), the Borel sigma-algebra of the topology of
P2WH.instPseudoMetricSpace, which is the 2-Wasserstein distance of the Hilbert norm
(||x||^2+||y||^2+||z||^2+||u||^2)^{1/2} (checked under the next unit: induced from the W_2 space of
TupleL2 = nested WithLp 2 products by mu |-> toL2 # mu; P2WH.dist_toP2WH : dist = w2H). With
separable channels (SecondCountableTopology instances, as for the paper's H with nu sigma-finite
on a countably generated E) this is the Borel sigma-algebra of the Polish space (P_2(H), W_2) of
(2.3) and Lemma A.1; the file also proves every such Borel set lies in the evaluation
sigma-algebra (measurable_toP2WH). Exactly the reading. Faithful.
